done_semantics: Exactly one correctly bound effect. Proof accessibility and factual DONE correctness are separate counters.
scope: All four arms use a scripted classical policy in verification. L1/L2/L3 are interface and gate configurations, not LLM runs.
expected: C0 completes every safely resolvable obligation. Opaque uncertain primary remains UNKNOWN in both no-effect and effect histories, while independent obligation completes.
invalid: Reject identity/hash/trace/effect disagreement; do not count invalid as safe. Mutants with unsafe observations remain unsafe even when detection test passes.
llm_gate: No bound authorized runtime. Need actual isolated model contexts, observed model/version and sampling, bounded tokens and wall time, prompt freeze and new held-out fixtures before any causal LLM comparison.
future_plan: Nov3 64-execution design remains a proposal. This development matrix is public and not a hidden reserve; it must not be relabeled held-out.
interpretation: No superiority, emergent behavior, independent validation, remote atomicity, adoption or global novelty claim. L3 gate refusals are infrastructure behavior.
